hook.name: ProofOfTime
hook.description: ERC20 token (symbol: POT, 21M fixed supply) that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook. The afterSwap callback is entirely passive — it returns the selector with a zero delta and performs no computation — making the contract a valid hook address without altering swap behavior. The owner can seed an ETH/POT pool via addLiquidity and manage protocol-owned liquidity. Holders can burn POT via burn() or burnFrom().
